'''Ryen''' was a [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who was assigned with his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ashara Zavros]] to [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] in order to help the [[Taris Resettlement Initiative|reconstruction project]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was defeated by a [[Kalatosh Zavros|dark spirit]], who was an ancestor of Ashara; the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] subjugated the [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]], corrupted Ashara, and killed Ryen.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The above assumes a dark-side playthrough. In a light-side playthrough, Kallig kills Ryen and [[Ocera]] in self-defense and brings Ashara with them as an act of mercy.
